newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 24:

WASHINGTON - With polls showing him behind and losing ground, Robert Dole dispatched his campaign manager to Dallas to ask Ross Perot to pull out of the presidential race and endorse the Republican ticket.

WASHINGTON - A tidal wave of money from both the Democratic and Republican parties is flooding the 1996 campaigns, giving the parties a greater role in presidential and congressional races than ever before.
WASHINGTON - A three-year-old Northeast Washington boy missing since Tuesday was found in Southeast Washington and returned to his family amid a cheering, crying crowd.

DEARBORN, Mich. - Newt Gingrich, the politician who once called himself a "transformational figure" and vowed openly to "shift the entire planet" could be found this week doggedly trudging through Middle America in a gruelling bid to save the Republican Congress and his own job.

WASHINGTON - The nearly simultaneous disappearances of two Washington area children have provoked an outpouring of anguish from parents and child care providers who say the cases remind them how vulnerable young children are.
JERUSALEM - A year after a Jewish assassin gunned down Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin this remains a divided and bitter nation.
